description: This file defines a PHP class 'QuestionnaireCreateTranslateForm' within the Goteo project, responsible for creating a translation form for questionnaire questions. It includes methods for adding questions in a specified language and constructing the form.

classes.name: Goteo\Library orms\QuestionnaireCreateTranslateForm
classes.description: A form processor class for creating questionnaire translation forms, allowing questions to be translated into different languages.

methods.name: addQuestion
methods.description: Adds a question to the form with a specific language translation.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Constructs the form by adding all questions in the specified language and a submit button.
